d: US President Donald Trump has admitted his immigration crackdown was “too tough”, signalling a shift in tone after Republicans suffered a major defeat in the midterm elections. In an interview with CBS’s 60 Minutes, Trump said he deserved an “A plus” for securing the border but acknowledged that sweeping deportations had politically hurt his party. He said the crackdown also affected people with jobs who had entered the US illegally.
